questionSnapshot.question: In Brave, what does the spell Merida uses on her mother accidentally turn her into?

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged intention versus outcome: Merida intends to change her mother, but the bear transformation is unintended. The primary story summary explicitly identifies Elinor as a bear; deer, wolf and fox do not fit. Cake question 1309 tests the mechanism/food, a different fact.
